season_futures#bowl_eligibility_rule.detail: Defect confirmed and partly mis-stated in the todo: verified from NCAA primary reports (FOC 2022-03-24: one FCS win counts only if the opponent averaged 80% of max grants-in-aid over two years, not 90%; legislated alternate order a-d; FBSOC 2026-05-07 and DI Cabinet 2026-06-23/24: Proposal 2026-30 adopted final, removing descending-APR ordering of 5-7 alternates, 930 floor kept; 2026-31 adopted final, reclassifying FCS-to-FBS programs bowl-eligible). The 'APR order' fallback in the blocker is obsolete for 2026. Patched cfb.bowl_selection_state (input_patches/CFB_a.json: mechanism, rationale, exact countable-wins/alternate measurement, raw_data with opponent division, FCS aid flag, APR, reclassification status, sources); season_futures stage s7 text and required_data bowl dataset updated; residual (FCS aid averages unpublished; title-game 6-7 treatment) kept in the bowl_eligibility_rule entry.

touchdown_scorer#player_series_missing.detail: Verified 2026-11-08 on the Kalshi public series API: no CFB named-player TD series exists (only TEAMTD, TOTALTD, TEAMRSHTD, TEAMRECTD, DSTTD, FIRSTTDTEAM; the NFL has KXNFLANYTD/FIRSTTD). series_assignment.json already re-filed all six to game_stat_props and the touchdown_scorer record is NO_LIVE_SERIES with player inputs audited WEAK, but the catalog game_stat_props entry lacked the TD-count inputs. Fixed: game_stat_props record new_inputs now attach cfb.td_per_scoring_trip, cfb.td_count_dispersion, cfb.dst_td_propensity, cfb.first_td_race_rate and cfb.goal_to_go_run_pass_mix as primary (identical definitions, merged by integrate); player_series_missing text updated to the dormant state. Residual: catalog touchdown_scorer still lists player inputs as primary roles, which integrate cannot rewrite.

unreg:team_event_counting_specials#stat_.detail: Duplicate confirmed: cfb.opp_dropback_volume is cfb.script_adjusted_pass_attempts (dropbacks = attempts plus sacks, script-adjusted, already with opponent pass-rate-allowed term) evaluated for the opposing offence. Consolidated: removed from team_event_counting_specials new_inputs and audited DUPLICATE_OF:cfb.script_adjusted_pass_attempts there and in unreg:season_stat_leader (was KEEP_SECONDARY); all stage, coverage, interaction, nonlinearity and required_data references swapped; canonical input attached to team_event_counting_specials as primary with an opponent-view why; cfb.opp_dropback_volume patched to an alias definition. The archetype split itself (yards/TDs in game_stat_props, sacks/INT/FG/2PT/delay here) matches series_assignment.json.
